name: World Explorer
description: A 24-hour atlas of travel, geography and culture: Rick Steves' public-television tours of Europe at breakfast and again in prime time, DW Travel's European city reports, Geography Now's country-by-country profiles through the late morning, Kara and Nate's overland journeys, DW Documentary's long-form travel films and its slow-travel train rides at night, and Mark Wiens' street-food journeys -- with prime time organized as a nightly trip across the map (Europe, then Asia & the Middle East, then Africa & Latin America) and the small hours given over to public-domain travelogues from the 1910s to the 1940s.
